blocks.content: Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen
rem stands for root em. Every rem value is a multiple of the font size set on the <html> element, which browsers default to 16px.
When a user bumps their browser font size up to 20px, rem values scale with that. px values don't.
You don't need to convert every value manually. Think in rough equivalents. 1rem is about 16px, 1.5rem is about 24px, 2rem is about 32px. Round to the nearest sensible value and move on.
You'll use rem for font sizes, spacing, padding, gap, and breakpoints throughout this course.
